data.gender_notes: Fatooh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fatooh means 'Raiser' or 'Opener'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history as it was given to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) when he was taken to Jerusalem during the Mi'raj (Ascension to Heaven). The name symbolizes the opening of the way to God and the raising of one's spiritual self towards Him. The name Fatooh carries the meaning “Raiser, Opener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatooh usually hope their child will grow to embody raiser, opener and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Fatooh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Raiser, Opener.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatooh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
